body.p: Goose God. It's sung like this. Seven Syrians woke up at dawn. Their youngest sister said: "The seven Syrians do not speak, they do not tell the truth. They will tell us what land they went to at dawn." Three moose. She harnessed the front one by the horn. She followed the footsteps of the seven Syrians. She followed the bends of their road to some land. As she approached, her seven Syrians were fighting their way through the troops surrounding them on all sides. They were only chopping with sabers. She stopped and said: "Seven elder brothers, while you are still alive, let's go home!" But none of the seven brothers wants to go home. And then from the sky, from the air, spinning, fell down the Goose-God - Tyaptu Kakhetiaai. Passing between the brothers and the army through, he created forever the Great River - Ob. The end.
